en: A sepia-toned historic street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with 2–3‑storey buildings. In the foreground is a large, low building with a metal roof, wide steps, and a colonnaded veranda crowded with people, suggesting a market hall or similar public building. Pedestrians, including women in long dresses and children, walk along the street. At the top of the image the word "DÜNABURG" is printed in capital letters.
